entry.title: Bratislava Castle
entry.note: Fresh grounds way1128350263 v23 identifies Q593311; palace way8160490 identifies Q13425656. Native +X NNE at 31.587323 degrees clockwise from north and +Z ESE at 121.587323 degrees sign heading 1.019493535917 at [17.100792149,48.142390437]. Southwest Crown Tower, south triple portal/Court of Honour and north Baroque garden confirm the frame. Current hedge/path vertices differ from original up to 0.570799 m; derivative uses fresh points while original source remains reproducible. All four gate centers and tunnel directions follow mapped passage/footprint intersections; three original tunnel bearings were transverse to their roads and have been corrected. Public numeric terrain supplies 16641 values on a 4 m native grid. Decoded Y0 working datum 202.3571 m; palace/court floor 5.2147 m above anchor is highest occupied platform sample plus 0.25 m, with rigid -4.7853 m translation. Garden/riding hall retain this interpreted level. Other barracks and gates use separate footprint/entry samples, bounded ramps and buried retaining feet. The broader hillside/park remains exclusively host terrain, with no ground cut or whole-grounds replacement. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
